Condition_Text: Licensee has full priority recovery if the Negative Milestone Delta is greater than zero.

Negative Milestone Delta equals aggregate milestone payments actually paid under Section 4.2 plus accrued Minimum Preferred Return for Fund limited partners minus aggregate milestone payments actually received from the Ultimate Licensee.
BCME has no standalone commercial royalty obligation to Vaximm.
Delta recovery ceases upon termination unless otherwise agreed.
Full recovery of the Negative Milestone Delta, including the Minimum Preferred Return, must occur first.
Licensee passes royalty receipts directly to Licensor and retains no ongoing royalty spread or economic participation following recovery.
BCME has no standalone commercial royalty obligation.
Applies only if Vaximm elects to draw development capital from the BCM Royalty Fund.
Contribution is to a TAC Royalty Distribution Wallet for distribution to TAC holders.
If Vaximm does not draw capital, no TAC contribution obligation applies and royalties flow solely through Section 5.
